about: Seconds from the check route returning to the nudge (and every Explain my miss item) being ready in the Field guide view, polled the way the page polls GET /guide. The nudge and all Explain calls start together on their own threads at the first GET /guide after a missed check. Model: claude -p (grade_bench.CliLlm) standing in for Hermes, so every number includes claude -p's own start-up: a trivial one-line reply takes 5.2 to 6.0 s on sonnet and 7.7 to 8.2 s on haiku through the CLI (measured Nov 9, 00:25 CT). Haiku through the CLI is no faster than sonnet here because the CLI start-up dominates; inside Hermes the guide task inherits the 'approval' task (a fast model) and calls the provider directly. Not measured inside Hermes.
